messages.text: The magic miner 40t  can you pool mine with this machine to get daily rewards?? And can it run off a uk plug

Yes on both, Phil-style short answers.

Pool mining: it's set up for solo out of the box, but you can point it at any pool instead, just enter the pool's stratum URL and your worker in the dashboard. At 40 TH/s a pool pays you small, steady amounts rather than the all-or-nothing block shot.

UK plug: it takes 100-240V with an IEC C14 inlet, so a standard UK kettle-style IEC lead plugs straight in. The box ships with a US or EU cable, so grab a UK IEC lead or adapter.

Want me to check anything else on it?
What pools are best to enter with this unit and could u help sent one up for me to pool mine .thanks

For a unit this size, pick a pool with a low payout threshold so you actually see daily payouts: Ocean, Braiins and Public Pool are the usual picks, and CKPool if you want solo with a shot at the full block.

Setup is just three fields in the dashboard: the pool's stratum address, your worker name, and your BTC payout address.

I've asked JD, who handles the hardware here, to send you the exact stratum settings and walk you through it. The team's offline until Monday 10am ET, and it'll come to your email. What's the best address for you?
(email hidden) email address..I have not ordered the unit yet but I'm about to ..That would be great if u could have ur hardware team set one up to pool mine 50%and solo mine50% power for me

Got it, Matt. One honest note first: the unit points at one pool at a time, so a true 50/50 split isn't something I can promise. JD will tell you what's actually possible, failover or switching modes, and set your config up.

I've passed it to him with your email. Team's offline until Monday 10am ET, so the answer lands in your inbox then.

If you order now, the 40T is Batch 5 and ships November 14. Want me to get the cart ready?
